group_value: roll back if loss rises more than 15% over 200 steps

text: Link flaps mid-run are the nasty case for checkpointing. If NCCL hangs instead of erroring out, the watchdog has to trip before we lose the in-flight async save, otherwise we restart from a half-written shard set. Did the soak show hangs or clean aborts?

speaker: kofi
text: Hangs are the bad case, then. If the NCCL timeout is longer than our async save window, a flap can leave the writer committing a manifest over half-flushed shards. I'd want the saver to check rank heartbeats before it commits, and the symbol error alert could be what trips the early abort.

speaker: wen
